# Monochrome UI Skill

## Purpose

This skill converts colorful Next.js/Tailwind applications into a premium monochrome design system.

---

# Supported Technologies

- Next.js
- React
- Tailwind CSS
- shadcn/ui
- CSS Modules
- SCSS

---

# Color Palette

| Usage | Color |
|---|---|
| Primary | #161616 |
| Background | #FFFFFF |
| Border | #E5E5E5 |

---

# Skill Capabilities

## Refactor UI
- Remove gradients
- Remove colorful shadows
- Normalize cards
- Normalize buttons
- Normalize forms
- Normalize typography

---

# Accessibility Rules

- Maintain contrast ratio
- Preserve focus states
- Keep keyboard navigation working

---

# Design Standards

## Buttons

```tsx
<button className="bg-[#161616] text-white rounded-lg px-4 py-2 hover:opacity-90">
  Button
</button>
```

---

## Cards

```tsx
<div className="bg-white border border-gray-200 shadow-sm rounded-2xl p-6">
  Content
</div>
```

---

## Inputs

```tsx
<input className="border border-gray-300 bg-white text-[#161616] rounded-lg" />
```

---

# Forbidden Styles

Never use:
- gradients
- neon
- glow
- colorful UI
- rainbow charts
- heavy shadows
- glassmorphism

---

# Final Style Goal

- Clean
- Minimal
- Enterprise
- Professional
- Modern SaaS
